name: Drama 3 TTS
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: A Gradio Workflow app that runs fishaudio/drama-3 (35B MoE, 3B active per token) in-process on a ZeroGPU large slice (RTX Pro 6000, 48 GB) via one @spaces.GPU function node. Record or upload a voice sample, type what that sample says, and generate a new line in that voice. The built-in toggle switches between the app view (the cloning page, styled after fish.audio) and the Workflow canvas (re-wire nodes, edit settings, save the graph).
Hardware: this Space must run on ZeroGPU hardware (Settings → Hardware → ZeroGPU). On CPU hardware the page opens, but Generate asks you to flip the hardware.

Inference uses the official PyTorch path of the model, vendored under fishspeech/ (adapted from hugging-apps/fish-audio-drama-3 via akhaliq/drama-3-tts): the 32.2B FP8 MoE experts stay in FP8 — dequantised they would need 67 GB and would not fit the slice. The model loads at module scope, as the ZeroGPU docs recommend: built on the meta device, materialised on CPU with FP8 experts, then moved to cuda, so startup costs no GPU time. spaces is imported before CUDA is initialized.
